name: Mistonia no Kibou -The Lost Delight-
original_name: ミストニアの翅望 -The Lost Delight-
source:
A fairy-tale filled with love and fixation, woven together by those who carry the blood of the fairies. The story takes place in Grand Albion, a kingdom thriving under the rule of the fairy queen. It is toward the end of the 19th century, an era where light and shadow coexist.

Our heroine, Aprose, suddenly had her family, her loved ones, and her hometown taken away and swore to mete out revenge on those behind the events of that fateful day.

Now, 8 years have passed. Whilst hiding her identity, she begins her search for the truth as she works at a mansion belonging to a potential target for her vengeance.

What secrets will she unearth upon her chance encounters with the distinguished noblemen who protect the kingdom? What path will she choose…?

And so begins the revenge tragedy of a girl bound by a hapless fate.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/mistonia/]Aksys Games[/url]]
translation:
這是由身負妖精血脈的人們編織的童話，裡面有愛，也有執念。故事發生在19世紀末，光明與陰影並存的時代。在妖精女王的統治下，大阿爾比昂王國正值盛世。

一場突如其來的變故奪走了亞普蘿絲的家人、所愛之人和故鄉。她發誓，要讓一手造成這場慘劇的人付出代價。

八年過去了。她隱姓埋名，到一座貴族宅邸裡做工，暗中追查當年的真相。宅邸的主人，便是她懷疑的仇人之一。

當她與守護王國的顯貴們不期而遇，她會揭開什麼秘密？又將選擇怎樣的道路……？

一個命途多舛的少女，就此拉開了復仇悲劇的帷幕。
